title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Change-of-Sailing Re-review and Withdrawal Charges
content:
Two events can put a charge on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file without any change to the goods themselves: the booking being moved to a different sailing, and the shipper pulling approved goods back out of the shipment before they are loaded. The tariff card below states, for every category, whether a move to another sailing sends an approval back to review, the fee for such a re-review, and the fee for withdrawing approved goods. Amounts are US dollars.

| Category | Approval reopened when the booking moves to another sailing | Re-review fee per change of sailing (USD) | Withdrawal fee for approved goods (USD per acceptance) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | No | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | Yes | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | Yes | 75.00 | 100.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | Yes | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | Yes | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | Yes | 250.00 | 400.00 |

## Reading notes

- AHL DG Limited Quantity is the only category in which moving the booking to a different vessel voyage leaves an approval standing; its re-review figure is accordingly 0.00.
- The withdrawal figure is a per-acceptance amount and concerns goods that had already been approved; for AHL DG Limited Quantity it is also 0.00.
